verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Orb's dunning capability is limited to automatic retry scheduling (1,4,9 days) after failed payment attempts, but there is no mention of network account updater, backup payment methods, or hosted update-payment pages — features typically owned by the payment processor Orb integrates with (e.g., Stripe). Missing for 10: any documentation of account updater support, backup payment method fallback, or hosted payment-update pages.
